violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above uncooked sliced pork back inside the Delfield 2 Dr UR refrigerator in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: CFM relocated the raw shelled eggs to the bottom shelf inside the Delfield 2 Dr UR refrigerator in the main kitchen.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: turkey wraps, deli sliced turkey and shredded cheddar cheese inside the Delfield and Central 2 Dr UR refrigerators in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM placed date marked label on the turkey wraps (5 remaining days), deli sliced turkey (6 remaining days) and shredded cheddar cheese (5 remaining days) inside the Delfield and Central 2 Dr UR refrigerators in the main kitchen with remaining hold dates before discard.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: unlabeled plastic bucket of play dough. CFM stated students use the play dough to practice rolling for baking.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: CFM labeled the plastic bucket of play dough.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: Observed shredded cheese in ziplock bag dated 10/12/25 and 3 ziplock bags of cubed cheese with no date marking.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with Certified Food Manager, the cheese will be discarded. Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solution that is being used.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Obtain a LACTIC ACID test kit. Alternatively revert to using Quaternary ammonium sanitizer ( QUAT Sanitizer ) or Chlorine ( Bleach ) sanitizer at the facility .

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @ food preparation area is providing a maximum of 88F of hot water through the mixing valve.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.
